speaker: Sheldon
text: You tampered with my experiment? It was the only way to keep you from being such a huge Dickensian. You see that? I added the 'ensian'.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Did Leonard know about this? Leonard's my best friend in the world. Surely Leonard didn't know. Of course it was. The whole plan reeks of Leonard.

speaker: Leonard
text: We had to. Actually, it was his idea.

speaker: Penny
text: I missed you so much. I couldn't think of anyone else while you were gone.

speaker: Leonard
text: I missed you too.

speaker: Leonard
text: Me neither. Except for one night when the heat went out. Long stories, don't ask.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard. Leonard. Leonard.

speaker: Leonard
text: Stop.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Whispering do not make a sound. It's a sound.

speaker: Leonard
text: Damn this Vulcan theory. Not a good time, Sheldon.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Penny. Hello, Penny. I realize you're currently at the mercy of your primitive biological urges, but since you have an entire lifetime of poor decisions ahead of you, may I interrupt this one?

speaker: Penny
text: It's great to see you too. Come on in.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Wallowitz has informed me of your grand deception. Do you have anything to say for yourself?

speaker: Leonard
text: Yes, I feel terrible about it. I will never forgive myself. I don't expect you to either, and I would really appreciate it if you would leave me with Penny for a session of self-criticism and repentance.

speaker: Penny
text: Can someone please tell me what's going on here?

speaker: Sheldon
text: What's going on is I was led to believe I was making groundbreaking strides in science when, in fact, I was being fed false data at the hands of Wallowitz, Scooter Polly, and your furry little boy toy.

speaker: Penny
text: Is that true?

speaker: Leonard
text: It was the only way to make him happy. Because when he wasn't happy, we wanted to kill him. There was even a plan. We were going to throw his Kindle outside, and when he went to get it, lock the door and let him freeze to death.

speaker: Penny
text: Why did you have to make him happy?

speaker: Sheldon
text: That seems like a bit of an overreaction.

speaker: Leonard
text: No, the overreaction was the plan to tie your limbs to four different sled dog teams and yell 'mash!'
